description: LEOKA officer fatality trends, weapons, activity, circumstances, demographics, geographic regions, and time-of-day/month breakdowns. Period "ytd" requests a year; "monthly" requires month and includes comparison-year monthly series. Both periods return the CDE YTD totals block, separately from month-specific breakdowns. Raw dod/doi totals have unspecified interpretation; classified deaths remain in the trend and region series.

month.description: Month number (1–12). Required when period is "monthly".

period.description: Data period: ytd for the year, monthly for month-specific breakdowns and comparison years. Both include the CDE YTD totals block.

year.description: Year to retrieve LEOKA data for. Required — the API does not default to a year.

name: fbi_get_leoka

body_armor_worn.description: Body armor worn category to count; null counts are unavailable.

deaths_by_region.description: Officer death counts by killing type then region. Keys: "Felonious", "Accidental". Values: { "South": 31, "West": 12, ... }

deaths_by_year.description: Annual officer death totals by type. Keys: "Felonious", "Accidental". Values: { "2022": 61, ... }

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `month_required`: period is "monthly" but the month parameter was not provided. `no_data`: The API returned no LEOKA data for the requested year/month. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

lighting_conditions.description: Count by lighting conditions at time of incident.

location_of_attack.description: Location of attack category to count; all reported categories are retained.

month.description: The data month, when period is "monthly".

offender_demographic.description: Offender demographic dimension to category to count; null groups and counts are unavailable.

offender_previously_known_to_agency.description: Previously known offender category to count.

offender_prior_mental_illness.description: Offender prior mental illness category to count.

offender_prior_relationship.description: Offender prior relationship category to count.

officer_activity.description: Count by what the officer was doing at the time of the incident.

officer_circumstances_time_of_attack.description: Circumstance at time of attack category to count.

officer_death_by_month.description: Killing type to year to month to count. Includes returned comparison years and zero values without filtering.

officer_death_by_time_of_day.description: Killing type to hour key to count. Hour keys, including -1, are preserved literally.

officer_demographic.description: Officer demographic dimension to category to count; null groups and counts are unavailable.

totals.description: Raw incidents_victim_officer_totals_ytd block, including in monthly responses. Not combined fatalities or requested-month totals.

total_incidents.description: CDE YTD total incidents from incidents_victim_officer_totals_ytd; not a combined fatality or requested-month count.

total_incidents_dod.description: Raw total_incidents_dod from the CDE YTD block; dod interpretation is unspecified.

total_incidents_doi.description: Raw total_incidents_doi from the CDE YTD block; doi interpretation is unspecified.

total_officers.description: CDE YTD total officers from incidents_victim_officer_totals_ytd; not a combined fatality or requested-month count.

total_officers_dod.description: Raw total_officers_dod from the CDE YTD block; dod interpretation is unspecified.

total_officers_doi.description: Raw total_officers_doi from the CDE YTD block; doi interpretation is unspecified.

weapons.description: Count by weapon type (e.g. Handguns, Rifles, Vehicle).

title: FBI Get LEOKA
